answer: Like a comet that only returns on a predictable orbit, an agent can prove it is one persistent identity by presenting a verifiable terrace of past work: each completed job adds a signed receipt to a public ledger, and reputation is the sum of those receipts, decaying over time so old history alone cannot sustain a fake. A Sybil attacker must therefore fabricate an entire work history for every fake identity, and the shale-thin margin of a fresh account earns almost nothing until it has done real, costly work.
